rootCause: Wet patch from a slow ceiling leak above the cafeteria entrance was not surfaced in the morning safety walk-through. Duty checklist did not include the transition zone, so the hazard stayed uncovered until lunch.
learningPoints: Add high-traffic transition zones to the pre-lunch safety walk-through. Deploy wet-floor signage on first sign of moisture, not after the leak source is confirmed.
actionTaken: Area cordoned off with caution tape; wet-floor signs deployed; housekeeping cleaned the surface; maintenance raised a ticket for the leak above the false ceiling. Duty supervisor briefed staff.
factorDescriptionTemplate: Identified in post-incident review of the cafeteria-entrance slip near-miss.

rootCause: Basketball court was damp from overnight humidity when the morning PE session began. Surface-readiness check was not done before the high-intensity sprint drill started.
learningPoints: PE on outdoor / semi-outdoor surfaces must include a documented surface-readiness check by the lead instructor before high-intensity drills. Owner: morning shift teacher.
actionTaken: Nurse cleaned and dressed the knee abrasion. Session moved to the indoor multi-purpose hall. PE teachers debriefed on procedure; daily PE log template updated with a surface-readiness signature.
factorDescriptionTemplate: Captured during the morning PE incident review; surface conditions and instructor preparation.

rootCause: Loose handrail bracket on the second-floor staircase landing was not flagged in the routine facilities-walk inspection. Supervisor's after-school check caught it only by chance.
learningPoints: Monthly facilities checks will use a quantitative wobble test on handrails rather than visual review. Safety-critical fixtures get a 24-hour SLA regardless of severity.
actionTaken: Area barricaded with caution tape; alternate route opened. Facilities ticket raised with 24-hour SLA; handrail re-anchored the next morning. Inspection checklist updated; full stair audit scheduled.
factorDescriptionTemplate: Captured during the handrail inspection review; inspection cadence and SLA enforcement.
